questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', NgayLapHoaDon) AS day_of_week, ROUND(SUM(TongTien), 2) AS revenue FROM HoaDon GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY revenue DESC;

questions.question: Ngày nào có nhiều hóa đơn nhất
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NgayLapHoaDon, COUNT(*) AS total FROM HoaDon GROUP BY NgayLapHoaDon ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Khách hàng nào đã mua bài hát Iron Maiden
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT KhachHang.Ten, KhachHang.Ho FROM KhachHang INNER JOIN HoaDon ON KhachHang.MaKhachHang = HoaDon.MaKhachHang INNER JOIN ChiTietHoaDon ON HoaDon.MaHoaDon = ChiTietHoaDon.MaHoaDon INNER JOIN BaiHat ON ChiTietHoaDon.MaBaiHat = BaiHat.MaBaiHat INNER JOIN Album ON BaiHat.MaAlbum = Album.MaAlbum INNER JOIN NgheSi ON Album.MaNgheSi = NgheSi.MaNgheSi WHERE NgheSi.Ten = 'Iron Maiden';

questions.question: Bài hát nào tốn nhiều bộ nhớ nhất
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Ten, DungLuong_bytes FROM BaiHat ORDER BY DungLuong_bytes DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Bài hát nào tốn ít bộ nhớ nhất
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Ten, DungLuong_bytes FROM BaiHat WHERE DungLuong_bytes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DungLuong_bytes ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Tổng số playlistTrack trong hệ thống
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM ChiTietDanhSachPhat;

questions.question: Track nào nằm trong nhiều playlist nhất
questions.gold_sql: SELECT BaiHat.Ten FROM BaiHat INNER JOIN ChiTietDanhSachPhat ON BaiHat.MaBaiHat = ChiTietDanhSachPhat.MaBaiHat GROUP BY BaiHat.MaBaiHat ORDER BY COUNT(ChiTietDanhSachPhat.MaDanhSachPhat) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Nhạc sĩ nào có tổng doanh thu cao nhất
questions.gold_sql: SELECT NgheSi.Ten, ROUND(SUM(ChiTietHoaDon.DonGia * ChiTietHoaDon.SoLuong), 2) AS total_revenue FROM NgheSi INNER JOIN Album ON NgheSi.MaNgheSi = Album.MaNgheSi INNER JOIN BaiHat ON Album.MaAlbum = BaiHat.MaAlbum INNER JOIN ChiTietHoaDon ON BaiHat.MaBaiHat = ChiTietHoaDon.MaBaiHat GROUP BY NgheSi.MaNgheSi ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;
